what: The Signature Generator makes a picture of a signature that you can put on documents, emails and forms. Type your name to see it in ten handwriting fonts, or draw your own signature on the screen.
You choose the ink colour (dark blue, black, blue and more), a slant and an optional flourish underline. The image is trimmed tight with a transparent background.
Download it as a PNG in small, medium or large size, or as an SVG that stays sharp at any size. Nothing is uploaded: the signature never leaves your device.
uses: Add a neat handwritten touch under your name.
Place the PNG on contracts or forms with a PDF tool.
Sign printed letters, awards and certificates.
Find a signature style you like before practising it on paper.
tutorial: Enter the name as you want it to appear.
Tap one of the ten handwriting styles.
Dark blue looks like a real pen. Add a little slant for a natural look.
Tick the box for an underline swoosh.
Small for email, Large for print.
Press Download PNG (transparent) or Download SVG, or copy the image.
Switch to Draw it, sign in the box, then download the PNG.
features: Elegant scripts and casual pens, all free fonts.
Smooth lines that get thinner when you move fast, like ink.
Dark blue, black, blue, green, dark red or any colour.
Fix the last stroke of a drawn signature.
Made in your browser, never uploaded.

example.title: Worked example: a signature for an email
example.text: Maria types "Maria Garcia", picks the Alex Brush style, dark blue ink, "A little" slant and the flourish, and chooses Small. She downloads a transparent PNG about 700 pixels wide and adds it under her name in her email app.

tips: Dark blue ink looks most like a real pen signature.
Use Large for documents that will be printed.
Short names look best in the bigger script styles.
When drawing, sign slowly for smoother lines, and use the full width of the box.
Keep your signature file private, like you would your real signature.
problems: The handwriting fonts cover Latin letters. Other alphabets show in a normal font; use Draw it instead.
The style has no shapes for some letters. Save it as PNG.
Some browsers do not allow copying pictures. Use Download PNG.
Draw a little slower, or use a stylus.
